name: Kaohsiung Museum of Fine Arts
known: Founded by the Kaohsiung City Government.
Run since 2017 by the Kaohsiung administrative corporation with the Kaohsiung Museum of History and Film Archive; its director sits on C-LAB's board.

name: Juming Museum
known: Founded by the sculptor Ju Ming (born 1938, died 2023), who began turning barren land in Jinshan into a park and museum in 1987.
It opened on 19 September 1999 after twelve years of work (museum's founder page, Wikipedia).
Named for its founder.
The museum's founder page states that Ju Ming funded the museum himself, using his lifetime savings.
Governance: the foundation's page lists a board of nine, chaired by 葉樹姍, with directors 王玉齡, 吳素美, 官政能, 林淑玲, 翁玉琴, 黃育徵, 鄭鉦涼 and 魏自立.
Run by the Ju Ming Culture and Education Foundation, which founder Ju Ming set up to keep the museum going.

name: National Taiwan Museum of Fine Arts
Tainan Art Museum
known: Leadership: the founding chair was the artist Chen Huei-dung (2017 to 2019; he died on 1 November 2024).
The director since March 2025 is Kung Chuo-chun.
Chinese Wikipedia lists five directors and five chairs since 2017, including a deputy mayor as chair in 2023 to 2025.
In 2018 Culture Bureau Director Ye Tse-shan said the museum's budget is set annually by need and that he hoped the museum would raise its self-financing rate (Da Cheng News, 2018).
Publishes annual reports 2019 to 2024, final accounts 2017 to 2025 and yearly donor lists to 2025; names only its chair, not the full board.

name: Hong-gah Museum
known: Founded by the businessman and collector Chiu Tsai-hsing (Andrew Chew).
Global Views named him as chairman of 繼業 (Jiye) in 2006 and as head of the electronics company 繼業電子 in 2001 (遠見, 黃茜芳, 1 November 2001).
It names only founder Andrew Chew and Chew's Culture Foundation.

name: MOCA Taipei
known: Directors: its activities became more international under Shih Jui-jen, and Loh Li-chen was director from 2019 to 2025 (Wikipedia).

name: National Palace Museum
known: Hsiao Tsung-huang has been director since January 2023.

name: Taipei Contemporary Art Center
known: About 30 people founded it as an association, which had around 70 members and used open board elections to avoid a single director (ART iT).

name: Taiwan Contemporary Culture Lab (C-LAB)
known: Its chairperson is Sue Wang, Deputy Minister of the Ministry of Culture.

name: TheCube Project Space
